verdict.rationale: Extensibility through plugins, taps, overlays, or backends is a fair question for a package manager, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a uv plugin system, third-party taps, overlays, or pluggable backends. The nearest items are adjacent features: alternative dependency sources (uv-docs-70) and `uvx --with` for adding packages to a tool run (uv-docs-14). Neither extends the manager itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extend the manager through third-party taps, overlays, plugins, or backends
